annotations.title: Meta insights as a background report

description: Meta insights for long date ranges or big accounts, where meta_insights would be too slow: Meta builds the report in the background. action start: objectId (a campaign, ad set or ad; omit for the whole account), level, fields, breakdowns, actionBreakdowns, datePreset or since + until (YYYY-MM-DD), timeIncrement (1 = daily, "monthly"), filtering; returns reportRunId. action get (reportRunId): progress while it runs, then the rows (pass after for more pages). An unfinished or failed report says so and is never shown as an empty one. Spends nothing, free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

breakdowns.description: start: e.g. age, gender, country, publisher_platform

fields.description: start: insights fields (default spend, impressions, reach, clicks, cpc, cpm, ctr, actions)

filtering.description: start: Meta filter objects {field, operator, value}

level.description: start: account, campaign, adset or ad

limit.description: get: rows per page, up to 500

objectId.description: start: campaign, ad set or ad id; omit for the account

name: meta_insights_report
title: Meta insights as a background report
